description:
Caught in a dire situation, Kyoko Sakura
is rescued by Mami Tomoe. Turn back
time to before Walpurgisnacht's descent,
for a story of two Magical Girls,
as they meet and part ways.
name: Farewell Story Part I

description:
"Dancing Magical Girls"
Five girls are recruited by Kyubey to cleanse impurities, one dance at a time! Then one day, a chance at a media debut lands in their lap...
name: Dance☆Magica

description:
Kyoko and Mami grew close fighting alongside
each other. But their bond begins to
unravel, and the two eventually part ways.
A year has passed since then. Now alone,
Kyoko encounters a black-haired girl.
name: Farewell Story Part II

description:
"Turning into a Magical Girl's made me a dummy!"
When 5 Magical Girls try to start a study session at
Mami's house, Hitomi's scream brings it all to a halt.
(Drama CD "Sunny Day Life")
name: Sunny Day Life Part I

description:
Madoka and the gang corner the Familiar
in an abandoned building, but aren't
prepared for what they find...
Their "sunny day" is just getting
started! (Drama CD "Sunny Day Life")
name: Sunny Day Life Part II

description:
"Welcome to the Yakumo Detective Agency!"
When a girl with "memories that shouldn't
exist" appears, Mitama is on the case!
name: The Case Files of the Coordinator 1: The Many-Worlds Interpretation Poesy

description:
Nervous transfer student Homura begins her
first day of school after a long hospital
stay. In trying to find her bearings,
she's approached by a certain girl.
(Drama CD "Memories of You")
name: Memories of You Part I

description:
Continuing her detective work, Mitama hears rumors
about a "Sketchbook of Misfortune" that seems to
predict the fates of those in its drawings...
"Leave this case to the great detective!"
name: The Case Files of the Coordinator 2: A Drifting Narrative

description:
Mabayu Aki, a student at Mitakihara Middle School,
sees time freezing for all but her. Searching for
the cause, she gets caught up in more mysterious
happenings, leading her to a certain Magical Girl.
name: Puella Magi Madoka Magica: Scene 0 Part I

description:
Crestfallen at her study and athletic failures,
Homura is lured into a Labyrinth—only to be saved
by Madoka, who first spoke to her at school.
(Drama CD "Memories of You")
name: Memories of You Part II

description:
Identical twins Tsukuyo and Tsukasa are like two
peas in a pod. So it comes as a shock when a new
Black Feather recruit says they don't seem like
twins. Can they get back their "twin-ergy"?
name: Two Hands in Harmony

description:
Mitama awakens inside a mysterious, old building
that seems oddly familiar. Then it hits her—it's a
replica of a dollhouse that was sent to her...
And so begins a new case for the great detective!
name: The Case Files of the Coordinator 3: Cozy Cosmology

description:
Madoka and her friends are on summer break!
They soak up the sun on a secluded beach,
and unwind with some retro gaming at night—
but not everything is as it seems...
name: Eternal Summer Days Part I

description:
Madoka and friends were enjoying summer vacation.
But as they played, a shadow crept across the sun.
What's real, and what's fake? It's all a haze...
Let's forget all that and have some summer fun!
name: Eternal Summer Days Part II

description:
Mitama creates a cafe space in the corner of her
shop for Magical Girls to gather and relax. But
when envelopes get shuffled up, it leads to three
choices and one interesting quandary...
name: The Case Files of the Coordinator 4: Moratorium on Misdelivery

description:
To avoid hampering a safety inspection
at Mikazuki Villa, Iroha heads out alone,
as her friends are all busy. But she
can't shake the feeling that maybe Yachiyo
and the others are up to something...
name: Iroha's Birthday 2025: Her Extra Special Day

description:
When Doyle the kitten goes missing,
Mitama sets out to find him. But the
search takes a sudden turn when a new 
disappearance soon follows. The Yakumo
Detective Agency's final case begins.
name: The Case Files of the Coordinator 5: Invisible Epiphany

description:
Sakurako Hiiragi—the Uwasa of the Eternal
Sakura herself—mysteriously comes to Emily's
Counseling Room to "learn." Her goal is to
adapt to human life, but as she listens to
their troubles, what else will she discover?
name: The Rumored Temp Counselor

description:
Mabayu saves Homura, gaining her trust.
With foresight guiding them down an
unchanging path, they race to stop
Madoka from making her contract,
until Madoka makes an unexpected wish...
name: Puella Magi Madoka Magica: Scene 0 Part II

description:
Mel seeks insight into the future, but
her fate points to misfortune. Avoiding
any trouble brings it knocking harder
than ever. Can Mel overcome disaster
and find the future she hoped for?
name: Defying Destiny: Forbidden Cards Call

description:
In a world now devoid of Witches,
Wraiths run rampant. Homura Akemi has
fought valiantly to defend the world that
Madoka wished for, but then a Wraith
unlike any other appears before her.
name: Puella Magi Madoka Magica: Wraith Arc

description:
Madoka can't decide what she wants for
her birthday when her parents ask.
But each heartfelt gift from her friends
helps her see what she truly longs for
on this once-a-year special day.
name: Madoka's Birthday 2025: A Gifted Predicament

description:
Mitama is cherished by honest and
open-hearted friends. To return the love,
she plans a meal made with gratitude. But
as for her culinary skills... Disaster may be
on the menu! Can Kanagi and Momoko
save everyone from this kitchen chaos?
name: A Taste of Hospitality

description:
Long before Iroha Tamaki ever set
foot in Kamihama... Momoko, still a
fledgling Magical Girl, crossed paths with
Yachiyo, Mifuyu, and apprentice Sumire on
the path that led her to Mikazuki Villa.
name: Magia Record Crescent Memoria Part 1

description:
In a world where Halloween never ends, the
holiday has grown dull and is in danger of
disappearing—unless Karin can save it!
"Don't worry, it's gonna have a happy ending!"
name: Forever Halloween Night Part I

description:
To bring back the joy of Halloween, Karin
 faces the ominous rumor of Artland.
 What chilling surprise awaits her there?
 "This is how we brought back Halloween!"
name: Forever Halloween Night Part II

description:
Hearts grow distant as time repeats,
yet Mabayu faces Walpurgisnacht again
and again. From understanding feelings
through the failures, one last reel
remains to be chosen...
name: Puella Magi Madoka Magica: Scene 0 Part III

description:
On an Alt-Universe Christmas... 
Magical Girls Sayaka and Kyoko of
St. Magica Academy fill in for Santa, but
surprises await as their route turns out to
be a merry minefield of Christmas calamity!
name: A St. Magica Academy Christmas: Part Nice

description:
Kids have found out Santa's true identity?!
Facing a crisis, the St. Magica Academy
student council uses Homura's magic to redo
Christmas Eve. Meanwhile, Kyoko and Sayaka
uncover a secret...
name: A St. Magica Academy Christmas: Part Naughty

description:
Christmas is almost here! But the mood throughout
town is rather gloomy. Empowered by a Christmas
Spirit, Rika and Ren arise to make the holiday
bright and joyful once again! Along with Chirpie,
they'll chase away the cowardly hearts!
name: Yuletide Tale: Where Our Hearts Begin

description:
After ending the year with a bad luck streak,
Madoka accepts Iroha's invitation to join
Mizuna Shrine's "hanetsuki ceremony," held to
pray for good health. However, she must first
win the shrine's hanetsuki tournament...
name: Prayers and Play Keep Sickness Away

description:
Tsuruno brings new life to Mikazuki Villa,
until an incident in Toyozuru disrupts the
peace. A mysterious Magical Girl weaves
trouble close as meetings and farewells echo the past.
name: Magia Record Crescent Memoria Part 2

description:
After learning the truth behind her sister
Komaki's death, Koito Asako didn't know how to
deal with Oriko's actions. Seeking answers, she
set out to learn about the Magical Girls of
Kazamino who, like Komaki, fell victim to Oriko...
name: Next Act: In Search of an Ordinary Life
Kioku Super Training Campaign EXP Quest

description:
Madoka gave her life to shatter fate itself,
freeing all Magical Girls from despair.
Unable to let go, Homura Akemi fights
alone in the world Madoka left behind.
name: Puella Magi Madoka Magica -Rebellion- Part I

description:
It's almost Valentine's Day! Meiyui ends up
making chocolates with Tsuruno after a visit
to the Coordinator. While she plans to give her
share to the Blue Seas Family members, her mood
changes upon learning Konoha will be helping out.
name: Homemade and Heartfelt Valentines

description:
A lonely girl finds her way to a ray of hope.
And a new "law" that defies all emerges as love.
"Just once, I want to see her again."
name: Puella Magi Madoka Magica -Rebellion- Part II

description:
In "Mitaki Hara" lies a magical bakery, where
worries of friendship and love alike are soothed
with enchanted treats. Valentine's may be over,
but troubled hearts still come seeking answers.
name: Sweet Magic from the Heart Part I

description:
Sayaka and Hitomi both want to give
chocolate to someone special—
only to realize it's the very same person.
Meanwhile, Kyoko and Mami's ideals collide,
sparking a contest of hearts.
name: Sweet Magic from the Heart Part II

description: In 15th-century France, a maiden hailed as "La Pucelle" was given the name "Darc" by an Incubator. Bearing the hopes and prayers of her people, she plunges headlong into the Hundred Years' War. What awaits her at journey's end...?
name: Puella Magi Darc Magica Part I

description:
Sumire and Fuka seek a way to save Magical Girls
as the Mikazuki Villa gang closes in on the hidden
secrets of their kind. Caught between hope and
despair, Sumire confronts her wish... Another tale
of girls striving for the light of dawn unfolds.
name: Magia Record Crescent Memoria Part 3

description:
While tidying shelves at A-Q's request,
a falling object causes a once nameless
girl to awaken in an unknown place with
floating portraits and familiar strangers.
name: Portraits of the Past and Promise

description: Taking place in Magia Exedra's comic, Magia Et Cetera, a stamp rally to earn the right to become a Kioku is now underway! What kind of chaos awaits in these four worlds? Will our three paper-thin protagonists proceed to procure proper 3D proportions? Make sure to take a break from level grinding to find out!
name: Magia Et Cetera Lighthouse Stamp Rally

description:
While searching for the missing Felicia in town,
Iroha and the gang meet three Magical Girls:
Shinobu, Mayoi, and Yotsugi. Strange gaps in
their memories begin to surface, as a tale of
seeking truth and a place to call home unfolds.
name: Monogatari Series Collab Part I: Labyrinth Story

description:
Together with Shinobu, Mayoi, and Yotsugi,
Iroha and the others search for a way out of the
mysterious world they are trapped in, but a
presence blocks their escape. Bonds forged across
different tales now draw them toward the truth.
name: Monogatari Series Collab Part II: Labyrinth Story

description:
In the 15th century during the Hundred Years' War,
Magical Girl Darc fights alongside the French army.
After liberating Orléans, they march onward to
Reims, seeking the coronation of Dauphin Charles...
name: Puella Magi Darc Magica Part II Act I

description:
"France will be brought to ruin by a woman, but
saved by a maiden." At last, darkness reveals
itself as Isabeau de Bavière. What destiny awaits
the Magical Girl hailed as "La Pucelle"?
name: Puella Magi Darc Magica Part II Act II

description:
After the Magius incident, Kanagi goes to visit
her fallen friends and runs into Yachiyo and
Mifuyu. They begin to reminisce about the past,
as memories and regrets from the time when
Kanagi first became a leader come to light.
name: Rise of the Waning Moon

description:
A Doppel encounter during relief efforts in
Kamihama leads Mami to seek guidance from
Mitama in confronting the truth within her own
heart—a truth which she can no longer ignore...
name: Mami Tomoe: A Doppel Tale

description:
Magia Island. A tropical paradise rich
with nature. It is here that Homura and
her friends spend their days in peace—
until their hidden duty beckons...
name: Welcome to Magia Island Part I

description:
Magia Island's power resides in an orb resting at
its heart. And hot on the trail of the intruders
who seek it out are the 5 Guardians led by Kyoko
and Homura. Can they fulfill their duty by purging
the threat from the Witch and restoring peace?
name: Welcome to Magia Island Part II

description:
Summer vacation's almost here! But the Mikazuki
Villa gang have yet to make any plans. So when
a pool cleaning request arrives from Yachiyo's
distant relative who runs a hotel, their summer
plans are set for a splashing good time.
name: Hotel Pool Rescue: Poolside Panic

description:
Hinano heads the chemistry club alongside her
assistant, Emiri. One day, Hinano gets a chance
to study under her science icon for a month.
But will their bond survive this new synthesis?
name: Finding Our Formula

description:
The pool is ready to go, but summer fun is
interrupted by calamity—a typhoon has left the
hotel understaffed! Can the Mikazuki Villa gang
dive in and save the big day from washing away?
name: Hotel Pool Rescue: Staffing Snafu

description:
The ever-imaginative Kush learned a first
edition of her beloved series, Fable of
Farewell, told a unique version of the story.
While hunting for it with Kako, a darkness took
hold of her. "Hurry! Kyubey must be killed."
name: A Waking Dreamer After Dark

description:
Sayaka and her friends ventured to a lake for a
picnic and had a great time rowing around in a
boat. Eventually, they started preparing for
lunch, but Bebe wasn't done playing...
name: So Close, Yet So Far

description:
A story featuring Madoka, Homura, Mami, Sayaka,
Kyoko, and Bebe. Amidst the endless tapestry of
stories written, this place was but one of a
myriad of possibilities that may have existed.
name: -Rebellion- Nightmare Story

description:
Mami and her friends ventured to a lake for a
picnic, but they forgot the flatware!
She sends the others to find some, and
she's left alone with unease creeping in...
name: Moments to Myself

description:
Magia Et Cetera hits 100 episodes! It's a
party at the Lighthouse when a mysterious
gift arrives. Read new episodes weekly
(Tue) at 18:00 (UTC+9) for 30% added fun!
name: Magia Et Cetera: 100 Episodes & Zero Regrets Special

description:
Happy birthday, Iroha! Sadly, her special day
falls on a school day, but it's not all bad,
celebrating with friends all day long.
Now what is it that Rena's trying to say?
name: Iroha's Birthday 2026: A Summer School Special

description:
Madoka gave her life to shatter fate itself,
freeing all Magical Girls from despair.
Unable to let go, Homura Akemi fights
alone in the world Madoka left behind.
name: [Redux] Puella Magi Madoka Magica -Rebellion-

description:
After collapsing from overusing her magic,
Tsuruno dreams of the day she became an Uwasa.
There, she comes face-to-face with the other self
that her buried feelings created.
name: Hollow Utopia

description:
Quiet, uneventful days with trustworthy friends...
That was the life Homura thought she knew.
But then, another reality began to bleed through.
Which is real, and which is only a dream?
She meets her own gaze in the glass again...
name: Sweet Dreams and Shifting Realities

description:
What did she wish for at that moment?
Nagisa Momoe's past is unveiled...
name: Nagisa's Wish

description:

is rescued by Mami Tomoe. Turn back
time to before Walpurgisnacht's descent,
for a story of two Magical Girls,
as they meet and part ways.
name: [Redux Story] Farewell Story Part I

each other. But their bond begins to
unravel, and the two eventually part ways.
A year has passed since then. Now alone,
Kyoko encounters a black-haired girl.
name: [Redux Story] Farewell Story Part II

When 5 Magical Girls try to start a study session at
Mami's house, Hitomi's scream brings it all to a halt.
(Drama CD "Sunny Day Life")
name: [Redux Story] Sunny Day Life Part I

in an abandoned building, but aren't
prepared for what they find...
Their "sunny day" is just getting
started! (Drama CD "Sunny Day Life")
name: [Redux Story] Sunny Day Life Part II

description:
Nervous transfer student Homura begins her
first day of school after a long hospital
stay. In trying to find her bearings,
she's approached by a certain girl.
(Drama CD "Memories of You")
name: [Redux Story] Memories of You Part I

description:

Homura is lured into a Labyrinth—only to be saved
by Madoka, who first spoke to her at school.
(Drama CD "Memories of You")
name: [Redux Story] Memories of You Part II

description:
What Madoka wanted most on her birthday
was to gather everyone to take a special picture.
They all think hard about what photo to take.
One thing is sure—this will be a memory they cherish.
name: Madoka's Birthday 2026: A Special Group Snapshot

description:
Ashley and Riko are hot on the heels
of the mysterious Kawaii Group,
but then Kumanosuke the plushie is stolen!
Will he and Ashley be safely reunited?
name: Missing My Bear: Where Are You, Kumanosuke?

description:
A new student has arrived at Mitakihara Middle School.
While she keeps her distance from the others,
Madoka seems to draw her attention.
Is it possible that Madoka had made a new friend?
name: My Friend

description:
The game featuring Lilly is out!
Sorana is excited to play,
but she doesn't have enough cash!
Using AI, she starts marine salvage to get rich!
Anything for who she cares about!
name: Anything for Who I Care About!

description: Madoka, recognized as a full-fledged Magical Girl at last, now worries she will fall short of her more accomplished seniors. This marks the beginning of a new chapter in her life.
name: Steady Steps Forward: Magical Girl Dreams
